title: Feng Clan Takes a Pet
summary: The teleport actually lands Ye Fan, Hei Huang, Nannan and Li Heishui on Feng Clan Island, where the Feng Holy Lord's 1,500th birthday is about to be held and where they meet Xia Yiming. Though they still owe the clan three million jin of source, Ye Fan attends. Feng Huang's maid insults him as the dying Holy Body the princess divorced; Ziwei Sect's Zhao Fa offers medicine; and Jin Chi, the Little Peng King, challenges him before Feng Fenghuang smooths things over. On the way to Zitian City, the maid and old servant Paman Yi (Dragon Transformation 7th layer) ambush them with the Netherworld Prison. Ye Fan crushes them, and Hei Huang takes the maid as his 'human pet' and has the old man thrown toward the Western Desert. Zhao Fa then tries to trade source stones for Ye Fan's Dragon-Patterned Black Gold Sword and attacks when refused, but Ye Fan beats his men and takes the stones. Meanwhile, a Golden-Winged Peng elder urges Jin Chi to pass the Nine Saint Trials, but Jin Chi insists on killing the Holy Body first.
